Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?
How to acces the billing section

To access the billing section, follow these steps: 
1. Select the file type of the patient (OP, IP, new, or outsider). For a new patient, click on ‘F4’ to load the registration screen. 
2. For existing patients, search by document ID, mobile number, or name. 
3. Click on the ‘Elig. Discovery’ button to verify the patient's insurance coverage. 
4. Choose consultation or service for billing from the service list. 
5. For consultation billing, select a doctor to automatically populate available slot times. 
6. For laboratory or radiology items, select the item code or name and click ‘Add’. 
7. Select the payment category and allocate the cash/credit scheme to the patient. 
8. Click ‘Save’ to generate the service bill. 

For visual guidance, refer to the following image: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113256.png)
